content:
maya: Quick heads-up — Marketing wants to run a short case study with BlueHeron Labs. They did a pilot on Redwood Dedicated and hit our latency targets; product wants a launch post + short webinar spot. Need interview + legal clearance for customer quotes.
leo: love it. do we have permission to use logos and metrics?
anika: BlueHeron already agreed to be a reference, but we need explicit written approval for the 98% p95 metric and the excerpted quote. they asked for a draft before sign-off.
maya: putting a draft together now. tagging @samir for the quote sanity check and @legal-bot for compliance — BlueHeron touches PHI, so we need HIPAA-safe wording and a logo usage agreement. :lock:
samir: can confirm numbers — those were on Dedicated with q4 autoscaling test. happy to write a one-liner quote that’s accurate. propose: "With Redwood Dedicated, our inference latency dropped 3x and costs per request fell ~40%, enabling real-time features." ok to share?
olivia: that quote looks fine but legal will want it softened: avoid exact %s unless they're in the signed data share. suggest: "...latency improved dramatically and per-request costs dropped substantially..."
legal-bot: FYI — HIPAA checklist: anonymize PHI samples, avoid patient-level screenshots, confirm Data Processing Addendum applied. Need customer sign-off on quote + logo + any dashboard screenshots.
maya: thanks — I'll send the draft quote variants. timeline: want to publish the blog + social post w/ webinar registration in two weeks. can we get legal clearance in 5 business days?
leo: product can free up someone for a 30m interview next week. prefer Wed morning PST.
anika: scheduling poll sent to BlueHeron (they preferred Tue/Wed).
maya: draft quote A (more specific):
```
"BlueHeron: With Redwood Dedicated we saw p95 latency drop from ~420ms to ~140ms and cut per-request infra cost by ~40%, which let us ship streaming features to customers."
```
Draft quote B (more conservative):
```
"BlueHeron: Redwood Dedicated reduced our inference latency and infrastructure costs, enabling new real-time product capabilities."
```
Please respond which to send to the customer.
samir: I vote B to avoid having to re-verify exact p95 numbers in the PR.
olivia: agree B + ask BlueHeron if they'd like the specific numbers in a technical appendix (requires extra sign-off).
maya: sending draft B to BlueHeron now and asking for logo permission + whether they'd allow a short dashboard GIF (no PHI). pinging legal for expedited review once they reply.
legal-bot: Recommended contract text for logo use: "BlueHeron Labs grants Redwood Inference the non-exclusive right to display BlueHeron Labs' name and logo in marketing materials related to the joint engagement, subject to customer approval of the final assets." Add to outreach.
leo: can ops attach a sanitized graph (no patient IDs) instead of a GIF? smaller review surface.
anika: ops can produce an annotated latency graph without identifiers. will deliver PNG by EOD tomorrow.
maya: BlueHeron replied: they approved quote B, approved logo in JPG, but asked to remove direct p95 numbers — and they declined the dashboard GIF, ok with sanitized PNG. also requested cold-read of final blog before publish.
olivia: legal: can you sign off on quote B + logo clause as-is?
legal-bot: Approved with edits: add DPA reference and remove any text implying use of PHI. Provide customer with final copy and require written confirmation (email).
samir: updated one-liner to match edits: "BlueHeron: Redwood Dedicated reduced our inference latency and lowered infrastructure costs, enabling new real-time product capabilities."
maya: sending final to BlueHeron for sign-off and attaching logo + PNG. asked for publish approval and webinar speaker commitment.
BlueHeron-Rep: (customer) Thanks — we approve the final copy and attached logo. We'll have Jane (CTO) on the webinar panel. Looking forward to coordination.
maya: awesome — webinar speaker confirmed. timeline check: draft blog + hero assets by Fri, legal-signed copy and logo received, schedule rehearsal for speaker on Mon.
leo: I'll draft the webinar run of show and send to ops for slides.
anika: ops PNG completed and uploaded to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/blueheron/case-assets
maya: final checklist: 1) legal signed email from customer (received) 2) assets in shared folder (yes) 3) product interview recorded (we have slot Mon) 4) blog drafted (in progress) 5) promo calendar scheduled (in progress). aiming to publish in 10 business days.
samir: can someone add a short technical appendix for the docs site with exact perf numbers stored behind login? BlueHeron ok with that as long as it's gated.
maya: noted — adding to tasks and will coordinate gating with Docs & Security.
olivia: :tada:  nice work everyone. will update content calendar when blog is live.
maya: thanks team — wrapping up here. keeping this thread as the single source for approvals. :white_check_mark:
